result.instructions: Tools for Agiled, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the open deals in our pipeline and their values."; "Show the invoices that are past their due date."; "Find the contact for avery@example.com and her account.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Agiled data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run agiled_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run agiled_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run agiled_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. agiled_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: agiled_check_connection
tools.title: Check the connection
tools.description: Return the token's user and workspace scope. Run it first to confirm the API base URL, token and workspace. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/me.

tools.name: agiled_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts, with filters for email, full name and created or updated dates. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/contacts.

sort_by.description: Field to sort by. An unsupported field falls back to the default sort.

include.description: Comma-separated related records to include, for example accounts,assigned_user. Unsupported values are ignored.

created_after.description: Date in ISO 8601 form, for example 2026-01-31.

updated_after.description: Date in ISO 8601 form, for example 2026-01-31.

tools.name: agiled_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Return one CRM contact by id. Agiled API: GET /public/v1/contacts/{id}.

id.description: The contact id (from the matching list tool).

include.description: Comma-separated related records to include, for example accounts,assigned_user. Unsupported values are ignored.

tools.name: agiled_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a CRM contact. Pass an idempotency_key built from the external record id, so a retry does not create a duplicate. Agiled returns HTTP 422 when a field is invalid. Agiled API: POST /public/v1/contacts.

idempotency_key.description: Key for safe retries, for example crm-contact-1001.
